title: Chini Ka Chakkar, Health Ka Takkar!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

CHINI DIDI.look: [[CHINI DIDI]] is a small, sparkling white sugar cube with a sweet, slightly mischievous smile, wearing a tiny pink bindi and a tiny chef's hat, perched on a brightly colored kitchen counter.

PAPPU BHAI.look: [[PAPPU BHAI]] is a slightly overweight, cheerful man with a relaxed expression, wearing a vibrant, slightly wrinkled t-shirt and track pants, holding a cup of chai, sitting on a comfy couch.

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] is looking mischievous, winking at the camera.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Arre bhaiya, main Chini hoon! Meetha-meetha jaadu mera kaam hai!
scenes.say: अरे भैया, मैं चीनी हूँ! मीठा-मीठा जादू मेरा काम है!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] is looking mischievous, winking at the camera.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Ekdum jhatpat energy chahiye? Main hoon na, tension nahi lene ka!
scenes.say: एकदम झटपट एनर्जी चाहिए? मैं हूँ ना, टेंशन नहीं लेने का!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] is looking mischievous, winking at the camera.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Thoda khao, masti karo, dimaag chalega ek number!
scenes.say: थोड़ा खाओ, मस्ती करो, दिमाग चलेगा एक नंबर!

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] looks confused, scratching his head while holding his chai.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhidu, main Pappu! Chini Didi ki baatein sun raha hoon.
scenes.say: अरे भिडू, मैं पप्पू! चीनी दीदी की बातें सुन रहा हूँ.

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] looks confused, scratching his head while holding his chai.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Par yaar, aajkal aap har jagah dikhti ho, kya chakkar hai?
scenes.say: पर यार, आजकल आप हर जगह दिखती हो, क्या चक्कर है?

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] looks confused, scratching his head while holding his chai.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Zyada Chini matlab vajan ka lafda, sahi pakde hain!
scenes.say: ज्यादा चीनी मतलब वजन का लाफड़ा, सही पकड़े हैं!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] looks a bit smug, pointing to herself.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Sahi pakde hain, mere bhai! Zyada khaane se ho sakta hai lafda!
scenes.say: सही पकड़े हैं, मेरे भाई! ज्यादा खाने से हो सकता है लाफड़ा!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] looks a bit smug, pointing to herself.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Meri chhupne ki jagah? Bole toh chai, cold drink mein!
scenes.say: मेरी छुपने की जगह? बोले तो चाय, कोल्ड ड्रिंक में!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] looks a bit smug, pointing to herself.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Biscuit, nashta... Arre bhaiya, main toh har jagah hoon!
scenes.say: बिस्कुट, नाश्ता... अरे भैया, मैं तो हर जगह हूँ!

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] looks concerned, gesturing with his hand.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Ayyo, itna Chini? Yeh toh tension wali baat hai boss!
scenes.say: अय्यो, इतना चीनी? ये तो टेंशन वाली बात है बॉस!

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] looks concerned, gesturing with his hand.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Zyada meetha khaya toh sugar ka BP badh sakta hai!
scenes.say: ज्यादा मीठा खाया तो शुगर का बीपी बढ़ सकता है!

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] looks concerned, gesturing with his hand.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Agar kuch lafda lage, toh doctor ko phone karne ka!
scenes.say: अगर कुछ लाफड़ा लगे, तो डॉक्टर को फ़ोन करने का!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] is showing a "stop" gesture, looking serious but still friendly.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Arre bhaiya, thoda-thoda khao, zindagi enjoy karo!
scenes.say: अरे भैया, थोड़ा-थोड़ा खाओ, जिंदगी एन्जॉय करो!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] is showing a "stop" gesture, looking serious but still friendly.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Kam Chini, zyada masti! Ye hi mera asli mantra hai!
scenes.say: कम चीनी, ज्यादा मस्ती! ये ही मेरा असली मंत्र है!

scenes.image: [[CHINI DIDI]] is showing a "stop" gesture, looking serious but still friendly.
scenes.speaker: CHINI DIDI
scenes.line: Health ka balance banaye rakhega toh koi tension nahi!
scenes.say: हेल्थ का बैलेंस बनाए रखेगा तो कोई टेंशन नहीं!

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] gives a thumbs up, smiling broadly.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Bole toh, Chini kam, khushiyan gam nahi, barabar!
scenes.say: बोले तो, चीनी कम, खुशियाँ गम नहीं, बराबर!

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] gives a thumbs up, smiling broadly.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Apni health ka dhyaan khud hi rakhne ka, public!
scenes.say: अपनी हेल्थ का ध्यान खुद ही रखने का, पब्लिक!

scenes.image: [[PAPPU BHAI]] gives a thumbs up, smiling broadly.
scenes.speaker: PAPPU BHAI
scenes.line: Aap apni chai mein kitni Chini daalte ho, batao zara?
scenes.say: आप अपनी चाय में कितनी चीनी डालते हो, बताओ जरा?
